title: Latest Masayoshi Son Exclusive Interview: SoftBank CEO Says AI Will Be 1000 Times Smarter Than Humans, All Past Business Moves Are Just Warm-Up
key_facts: Masayoshi Son, SoftBank founder, chairman and chief executive, spoke on Blackstone's internal podcast with host Kristin Anderson.
He said AI will be 1,000 times smarter than humans, which may be achieved within ten years.
He said everything he did before is 'just a warm-up'.
Asked about slowing AI, he said 'I do not advocate actually slowing down. Technological development is actually the solution to this kind of problem.'
He said SoftBank has more than 30 robotics companies in its portfolio and has started mass production of robots in a physical AI factory.
He said he uses AI about three hours a day on workdays.
quote_evidence: "I do not advocate actually slowing down. Technological development is actually the solution to this kind of problem."
"We have more than 30 robotics companies in our portfolio, quietly preparing for the upcoming moment."
why_it_matters_hint: A leading AI investor argues for full speed and predicts machine intelligence far beyond human.
notes: Interview date not stated; reported 14 Oct 2026. English text appears translated, so quotes may be back-translated. Blackstone is a US investment firm (named in the article only as the podcast host).
